about: 회계 II › 계약관리 › 계약현황(E060912, 2026-10-13 원본 실측): 계약일자(금월(~오늘)) 계약 줄이 출력물에 — 열 일자-No. · 계약명 · 거래처명 · 항목명 · 수량 · 단가 · 공급가액 · 부가세 · 합계 · 청구예정월, 달마다 'YYYY/MM 계' 와 '합계'. 수량 2 × 10,000 → '2.00 · 10,000 · 20,000 · 2,000 · 22,000 · 01 . 03 . 05'. 청구예정월 □사용 으로 2월만 고르면 빠진다. 만든 계약 · 항목은 끝에 지운다.

js:(async()=>{const c='S'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-현황항목',unitPrice:10000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'PERIODIC',salesAccountId:null})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body.find((x)=>x.name==='월말청구');const p=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const r=await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-현황계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:'01,03,05',quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:'QA회계2'}]});sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',r.body.id);return r.status})()

shots.name: 계약현황
steps: js:(()=>{const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;const y=new Date().getFullYear();for(const [k,v] of [['청구예정월 시작',y+'-02'],['청구예정월 끝',y+'-02']]){const el=document.querySelector(`input[aria-label='${k}']`);set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))}return true})()
